headlines.headline: 100 Days From Tip-Off: Nevada's Steve Alford to Retire, Duke Adds On-Court Ads
headlines.detail: With the 2026-27 season 101 days from its Notre Dame-Villanova opener in Rome, Nevada coach Steve Alford announced he'll retire after 36 years, while Duke debuts on-court advertising at Cameron Indoor.

headlines.headline: NBA Media Day: LeBron Debuts With Sixers, Jokic Teases Extension, Vegas Bids Top $12B
headlines.detail: LeBron James and Kawhi Leonard spoke to media for the first time with the Sixers and Raptors respectively; Jokic hinted at a new Nuggets deal; Vegas expansion bids reviewed at $12-13 billion.

headlines.headline: Commanders' Daniels Avoids Elbow Surgery for Now as Giants Release Beckham
headlines.detail: Washington QB Jayden Daniels holds off on elbow surgery; Giants release Odell Beckham Jr. after 3 games; Achane (season-ending ACL) and McMillan (6-8 weeks) headline Week 3 injuries.

headlines.headline: AP Poll Shakeup: Wisconsin Stuns No. 6 Penn State, Florida Rockets to No. 8
headlines.detail: Wisconsin's late rally knocked Penn State out of the rankings entirely; Florida's rout of Ole Miss vaulted it to No. 8; Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith became the program's first 3,000-yard career receiver.
